title: Morphometry Analysis in Mice
author: Ed Leiter
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7rhhm36

steps.title: Measure total mouse weight
steps.instruction: Weigh the mice in tared containers using a Mettler scale.

steps.title: Collect and weigh abdominal organs
steps.instruction: Dissect the left kidney, right kidney, liver, and spleen from the abdominal cavity. For each organ, blot on paper towels and weigh wet (non-dissected) using a balance with 0.1 mg discrimination.

substeps.instruction: Blot left kidney on paper towels and weigh.
Blot right kidney on paper towels and weigh.
Blot liver on paper towels and weigh.
Blot spleen on paper towels and weigh.

steps.title: Collect and weigh heart
steps.instruction: Dissect the heart from the thoracic cavity, blot on paper towels, and weigh wet (non-dissected) using a balance with 0.1 mg discrimination.

steps.title: Measure tibia length
steps.instruction: Dissect the left tibia using surgical tools, clean off all soft tissue, and determine the length using a digital micrometer.

steps.title: Calculate morphometric ratios
steps.instruction: Compute the following ratios using the weights (in grams) and lengths (in millimeters) obtained:

substeps.instruction: Total kidney weight: Sum of left and right kidney weights.
Spleen weight:tibia length ratio (Spleen weight in g / Tibia length in mm).
Heart:body weight ratio (Heart weight in g / Body weight in g).
Heart:tibia length ratio (Heart weight in g / Tibia length in mm).
Total kidney:body weight ratio (Total kidney weight in g / Body weight in g).
Total kidney:tibia length ratio (Total kidney weight in g / Tibia length in mm).
Liver:body weight ratio (Liver weight in g / Body weight in g).
Liver:tibia length ratio (Liver weight in g / Tibia length in mm).
